name: AWS Third Louisa County Campus
summary: AWS withdrew a third Louisa County campus application after public resistance. Two other AWS campuses continued, making this a within-county siting contrast rather than a county without data-center investment.
proposal_description: AWS applied for a conditional-use permit for a third campus concept in Louisa County. The proposal was materially larger than a single building and sat within a county already hosting other AWS development.
site_afterlife: No verified alternative use for the exact proposed site is published here. Other AWS campuses in Louisa County remain separate operating-project observations.
evidence_note: This is not a never-treated county. Any causal design must separate the rejected third campus from other AWS and EdgeCore activity in the same county.

timeline.title: AWS files for a third campus
timeline.summary: Louisa County materials identify a conditional-use application for another campus concept.

timeline.title: Residents organize against the proposal
timeline.summary: Public reporting documented strong resistance during the application period.

timeline.title: AWS withdraws the application
timeline.summary: The third-campus application was withdrawn before approval.

timeline.title: County remains exposed to other data-center development
timeline.summary: The rejected proposal must be analyzed alongside the county's other active campus projects, not as removal of the entire sector.
